description: Use this before you place furniture, fixtures, plants, cars or lights in a plan. Finds items in the catalog by words such as bed, sofa or table, and by size such as w:1200. Use the item keys with plan.furniture and plan.against.

words.description: Words for the item, such as double bed, corner sofa or kitchen island, optionally with a size such as w:1200 for a width in millimeters.

name: search_furniture
title: Search furniture
